title: Measure the cells driving slow simulation
changes: Physics & record now shows actual global motion split counts and the largest driving cell. These are proposal counts, not time contributions.
Body state observations use one native read lock. All four complete prior-binary material records retain exact physical/work parity.
The pair-sweep shortcut is withdrawn: glass refuses an energy-creating candidate, oak/iron are slower, and ice changes fracture/losses.
Default glass still takes about 37 wall seconds per two physical seconds. Useful speed, coupled contact/elastic accuracy and adaptive cells remain open.
Earlier fixtures used brief detailed material windows followed by cheap rigid continuation. This lab has not recovered that architecture; conserved handoff and later-impact reactivation are next.
